landing.hero_p1: Ubumenyi bw'Imari y'Ibiribwa (FSFI) bufasha Guverinoma y'u Rwanda n'abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere kubona uko amafaranga agomba kugabanywa mu sisitemu y'ibiribwa. Bufasha kugena intego z'igihugu no kunoza ibisubizo byose.
landing.hero_p2: Ku Rwanda, FSFI ikoresha ibipimo 37 byashyizwe mu bikingi 8. Kugabanya neza imari kuri ibyo bikingi bishyigikira guhangana n'ibibazo no kugabanya ingaruka z'ibibazo bizaza.
landing.components_sub: Byashyizweho ku murima wa Rwanda kandi bihuza n'intego z'igihugu.
landing.feature1_desc: Menya, buri mwaka w'imari, aho umutekano w'imari uretta ku minsi ku mipaka y'ibipimo 37 n'ibice 8 bya sisitemu y'ibiribwa—kugira ngo minisiteri n'abafatanyabikorwa bashobore gutegura ikiganiro no kubika porogaramu z'isuzuma zisobanutse.
landing.feature2_desc: Kurikirana ingengo y'imari y'ubuhinzi mu buryo buhuza n'ibipimo bimwe—imiterere y'imyaka, impinduka z'imigabane, n'ubwiyongere-bwiyongere—kugira ngo ibiganiro by'ingengo n'ibice bimeze ku mirimo y'ukuri, hamwe n'imiterere y'FSFSI.
landing.feature3_desc: Gerageza uko ingengo yakoreshwa neza, uko ikagoboka, n'imyaka myinshi—harimo no guhuza na PSTA-5—mbere yo kwemeza ingingo, MTEF, cyangwa ubufatanye n'abafasha.
landing.feature4_desc: Kurikirana impinduka ku mwaka w'imari, mu bice by'ingenzi, no ku map y'igihugu iyo dufite amakuru, hamwe n'impapuro n'imenyesha zifasha abayobozi n'abafasha ingengo gukomeza imirimo.

about_page.hero_lead: Ubumenyi bw'Imari y'Ibiribwa ni sisitemu itanga ubufasha mu guhitamo. Bugufasha guverinoma y'u Rwanda kumenya aho winjiza imari n'ingaruka ziteganyijwe. Abafasha n'abafatanyabikorwa barashobora gukoresha amakuru amwe kugira ngo imari yabo ihure n'intego z'igihugu ku sisitemu y'ibiribwa no gukurikirana ibisubizo.
about_page.challenge_intro: Ingengo y'imari ya sisitemu y'ibiribwa igomba guhagarika intego nyinshi. Abayobozi bakeneye ibisubizo byerekana aho amafaranga agira akamaro, uko ingengo ihura no guhangana n'ibibazo, n'uko basobanurira abafatanyabikorwa n'abaturage.
about_page.challenge_q1: Amafaranga agiye he kugira ngo sisitemu isumbuke rwose?
about_page.challenge_q2: Ingengo ihura ute n'intego z'igihugu na PSTA 5?
about_page.challenge_q3: Ni uwuhe mubare w'ishoramari ukagabanya ingaruka z'ibibazo iyo zihagaze?
about_page.provides_fsfsi: FSFI ibara FSFSI, ikongerera hamwe ibipimo 37 mu bikingi 8 kugira ngo isobanure imiterere y'imari mu sisitemu y'ibiribwa, kugira ngo ingengo n'ishoramari bishingiye ku makuru.
about_page.card_assess_body: Erekana uko sisitemu y'ibiribwa ya Rwanda iri ku mpande zingenzi ku bisubizo no guhangana n'ibibazo.
about_page.card_gaps_body: Gereranya ibisubizo ubu n'ibigereranyo kugira ngo ahantu hakeneye iterambere hagaragare.
about_page.card_invest_body: Gufasha mu guhitamo aho amafaranga yongewe agira akamaro ku ntego z'igihugu.
about_page.card_track_body: Huza ingengo n'ibisubizo na PSTA 5 n'impinduka z'umwaka ku wundi.
about_page.components_intro: Ku Rwanda, FSFI yashyizeho ibipimo 37 mu bikingi 8. Bihuye n'imiterere y'igihugu n'intego zacyo. Kubyiterambere binyuze mu gutanga neza imari bituma u Rwanda bugera ku guhangana n'ibibazo bya sisitemu y'ibiribwa no kugabanya ibyago cyo gusenyuka nyuma y'ibibazo.
about_page.gov_budget_body: MINAGRI, MINECOFIN n'abafatanyabikorwa bakoresha FSFSI n'ibindi bikoresho kugaragaza ahantu ho mbere no kwemeza ingengo.
about_page.gov_perf_body: Reba niba ishoramari rigezaho ibisubizo byateganyijwe kandi ugereranye na PSTA 5.
about_page.gov_adv_body: Sangira amakuru n'abafatanyabikorwa kugira ngo imari yo hanze ihure n'intego z'igihugu ku sisitemu y'ibiribwa.
about_page.partners_intro: FSFI yakorewe hamwe n'amashuri makuru yo mu Afrika no ku isi.
about_page.cta_body: Injira ukoresheje amakuru yawe y'ubuyobozi kugira ngo ubone ikibaho.
about_page.footer_line: Ubumenyi ku nguzanyo z'imari mu sisitemu z'ibiribwa

auth.contact_admin: Hamagara umuyobozi wa sisitemu kugira ngo ugufashe
auth.two_factor_subtitle: Injiza kode imirongo 6 kuva ku porogaramu yawe
auth.invalid_2fa: Kode ntabwo ari yo. Ongera ugerageze.
auth.password_policy_hint: Byibuze inyuguti 12, intare na nto, imibare, n'ikimenyetso (amategeko ya seriveri).
auth.must_change_password: Ugomba guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga mbere yo gukomeza.
auth.session_expired_notice: Igihe cyawe cyo kwinjira cyarangiye kugirango umutekano urinde. Ongera winjire kugira ngo ukomeze.

security_settings.page_subtitle: Rinda FSFI yawe ukoresheje 2FA n’ijambo ry’ibanga rinini.
security_settings.lead: Ijambo ry'ibanga na 2FA bikurikiranwa na FSFI (Rust: Argon2id, TOTP, ubusobozi bw'ibanga).
security_settings.mfa_setup_blurb: Koresha aplikasiyo y'umutekano. Ubusobozi bwa TOTP burahungwa kuri seriveri.
security_settings.scan_qr: Sikana QR cyangwa wandike ubusobozi ukoresheje intoki.
security_settings.backup_codes_warning: Zibike neza. Buri kode ikoreshwa rimwe.
security_settings.confirm_6_digit: Injiza kode imirongo 6 kugira ngo ukomeze 2FA.
security_settings.password_blurb: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga niba riranze cyangwa nta mutekano.

profile_page.title: Umwirondoro
profile_page.subtitle: Amakuru y’ubuyobozi n’imiterere y’umutekano bw’FSFI ufite.
profile_page.manage_security_hint: Tegeko 2FA, kode zo gusimbura, n’ijambo ry’ibanga.

overview.plan_actual_hint: Nta byakozwe byanditswe. Koresha igikoresho cyo guhuzanya ingengo y'imari kugira ngo wandike ibyatanzwe koko.
overview.fsfsi_scale_hint: Imibare 0–1,0 · Irengeza risumba risobanura umutekano mwinshi w'imari
overview.chart_explain_blue: Ubururu — umutekano w'uyu mwaka gusa; impinduka z'ingengo zihita ziboneka.
overview.chart_explain_red: Umutuku (imirongo) — umutekano w'amateka n'ingaruka ; kugaruka biratora igihe.
overview.chart_explain_gap: Itandukaniro hagati y'imirongo ≈ uburemere bw'imari busigara nubwo ingengo zitera imbere.
overview.trend_subtitle_fsfsi: Imibare y'umutekano w'imari y'ibisystem by'ibyokurya ku myaka y'ingengo y'imari
overview.trend_subtitle_components: Imigendekere y'umutekano ku ibice mu gihe
overview.trend_subtitle_heatmap: Isesengura ry'ubushyuhe bw'umutekano ku bice no ku myaka

assessment_page.page_subtitle: Tangiza kandi usuzume FSFSI ku mwaka w’imari. Ibisubizo by’ingenzura birabika kugira ngo ubishakire kandi ugerezanye ibisubizo bitandukanye.
assessment_page.saved_list_intro: Fungura isesengura kugira ngo ubone ibice n’ibimenyetso byuzuye. Hitamo kugeza ku bine kugira ngo wugereranye ibipimo nk’uko bikwiye.
assessment_page.compare_need_two: Hitamo nibura kabiri ukoresheje akazu kugira ngo ugereranye.
assessment_page.fsfsi_kpi_explainer: Umubare wo hejuru uva ku isesengura ryakomeje rishyizwe kuri {{fy}}. Nimba hari ibiharuro bibiri, rinini ni umutekano uhambaye (gushyira ku bw’imyaka ishize niba urubuga ruyakoresha). Akabari gato ni uyu mwaka w’imari wenyine. Icyanditse mu rutonde ni FSFSI y’icyo gikorwa; gihura n’ikibaho gusa niba ari icyo kiboneka, uburyo bw’ibikoresho, n’imiterere kimwe n’isesengura ryanyuma ry’incamake.
assessment_page.efficiency_hint: FSFSI yo gukoresha neza ÷ FSFSI y’ukuri (uyu mukerere). 1.0 bivuze ko umutekano uhwanye n’imiganu itunganyije; imbere y’1.0 byerekana umutekano munini kuruta iby’imiterere idasanzwe — hari aho kunoza uguha imari.
assessment_page.detail_vs_dashboard_note: Ikarita hejuru itangira ku FSFSI ihambaye iyo seriveri itanga. Ibi ni FSFSI y’igihe kimwe cy’uyu mukerere. Nimba umubare utandukanye, gereranya ihambaye n’igihe kimwe, unasuzume uburyo n’imiterere hepfo.
assessment_page.gap_legend: Itandukaniro: ✓ ku cy’imiterere cyangwa neza kuruta cyo. Umwambi n’umubare = intera itandukanya n’imiterere ku kimenyetso — si impinduka mu myaka (umwambi ntabwo bisobanura ‘bibi mu myaka’).
assessment_page.gap_tooltip_off_benchmark: Itandukaniro n’imiterere muri iki kimenyetso ; umwambi werekana intera, ntabwo ni impinduka hagati y’imyaka.

optimization_page.title: Gucunga neza ingengo y’imari
optimization_page.subtitle: Isesengura rya Rust rigereranya ingengo y’imari ku byiciro n’imiganu idasanzwe yo kugabanya FSFSI, ku ntambwe imwe y’ingengo y’imari.
optimization_page.method_note: Rifata isesengura ryanyuma ryabitswe ku mwaka w’imari wahisemo. Igisubizo ni inama z’uko kwihinduranya, ntabwo ari amabwiriza y’ingengo y’imari.
optimization_page.fy_selector_hint: Guhitamo isesengura rikoreshwa nk’iyinjizo; imyaka itagira isesengura ntiragaragara.
optimization_page.no_assessment_body: Banza ukore isesengura ya FSFSI. Uru rupapuro ruzakora optimization ku bw’ibuso ku bwanditswe bwa nyuma.
optimization_page.preview_running_body: Seriveri ibarura ubuhinga, guhaguruka, na ROI. Bisaba indaki icumi zikagera ku minota imwe uretse imirimo.
optimization_page.preview_idle_body: Reba icyo bizuzura. Ibisubizo bihinduka niba uhindura umwaka cyangwa ukongera gukora.
optimization_page.preview_output_efficiency: Ingano y’ubushobozi, FSFSI y’ubu n’idakwiye, itandukaniro ku bice
optimization_page.preview_output_reallocation: Guhaguruka mu bice ku mubare umwe w’ingengo
optimization_page.preview_output_roi: Imyanya ya ROI ku kugabanya umutekano ku bice
optimization_page.time_hint: Akenshi ni amasegonda ageza ku minota imwe ku bice bitatu.
optimization_page.results_lead: Ku iyi sesengura: FSFSI {{current}}, hafi ya {{optimal}} n’imiganu idakwiye; ubusa bw’ingaruka ni {{waste}}%.
optimization_page.rerun_title: Kongera ibarura bitatu ku sesengura iriho
optimization_page.card_efficiency_sub: Ingengo y’ubu gereranya n’imiganu idakwiye ku mubare umwe.
optimization_page.card_reallocation_sub: Gahunda yo guhindura imari mu bice.
optimization_page.card_roi_sub: Imyanya ku kugabanya umutekano ku biliyoni RWF.

planning.title: Gahunda y'Ingengo
planning.subtitle: Intambwe ya FSFSI y'imyaka myinshi na MTEF kugira ngo habe ingingo z'igihugu.
planning.no_assessment_message: Kora isuzuma FSFI k'umwaka w'imari watoranijwe kugira ngo ushobore gahunda na MTEF.
planning.parameters_help: Shira ingingo n'igihe; gahunda y'imyaka myinshi na MTEF y'imyaka 3 bihanitse.
planning.horizon_start_fy_hint: Huza imirongo n'imyaka (2 = +1, n'ibindi). Mburabizi: umwaka ukurikira isuzuma.
planning.alignment_help: Fungura umwaka: injiza ingengo ku bice (mds RWF); igiteranyo ni inyongera. Imigisha ya % ihinduka. Gereranya n'igenzura kandi FSFSI y'amateka n'imvange yawe.
planning.alignment_cumulative_note: Injiza ingengo wifuje ku bice by'ubworozi n'ibiribwa hepfo. Igikoresho kirerekana uko imigabane yawe ihura n'igenzura cyiza kandi giteganisha FSFSI y'igihugu muri uwo mugabane n'igiteranyo.
planning.alignment_mix_help: Amafaranga yongera ku mubare w'igihugu. '% yawe' iva ku mugabane (100%).
planning.alignment_footnote: Ikoresha ibipimo wahisemo. Kuri FSFSI yemewe, kora isuzuma.
planning.mtef_growth_rate: MTEF igipimo cyo kwiyongera k'ingengo y'imari
planning.regenerate_plans_hint: Kongera gutunganya gahunda n'ibisabwa n'isuzuma biriho. Koresha nyuma yo guhindura intego, iyongera, ibipimo, cyangwa scenario.
planning.workflow_hint: Ibisubizo nibone, koresha udu tab hepfo ku makuru ngenderwaho kugira ngo ucyure intambwe, ibice, guhuzanya ingengo, MTEF, n'ibisubizo utasubira ku rupapuro rose.
planning.tab_mtef_unavailable: MTEF ntabwo iraboneka. Hanga gahunda ukoresheje isozuma rimwe cyangwa fungura gahunda yabitswe ihuye.
planning.save_state_note: Kubitsa biguma ibisabwa n'igenzura ry'ingenzi (intambwe n'imvange nziza). « Bika nk'ukuri » mu guhuzanya ari kitandukanye: bibika imigabane wanditse kugira ngo ukurikire, kandi bikenera gahunda yamaze kubikwa.
planning.mtef_year3_off_track_intro: FSFSI biteganijwe ni {{projected}}, hejuru y'igenzura rya politiki ({{policy}}) cyangwa intego yo gukemura ({{operational}}). Ku iyi mibare, hasi ni byiza kuruta hejuru — ingengo y'imyaka itatu isaba kugabanya stress vuba kuruta uko ingengo y'imari ishobora.
planning.mtef_year3_off_track_levers: Uburyo bwo gerageza: wongere kwiyongera k'ingengo y'imari ku mwaka, subiramo % y'ijanisha ya MTEF imyaka 3, hitamo intambwe ihuye n'imbaraga z'imari, cyangwa ohereza ingengo ku bice bifite stress mwinshi mbere yo wongera ikigari cyose.
planning.mtef_targets_curve_note: Intego za politiki zikurikira umurongo w'imyaka itatu. Intego z'imicungire zikoresha intambwe wahisemo ({{curve}}).
planning.component_table_subtitle: Stress y'amateka biteganijwe ku bice ku gihe cy'gahunda. Ihuta ryo gukira rigenda ku murimo w'umwanya n'ingengo yawo.
planning.component_table_sort_hint: Imirongo irihejuru ni yo ifite kugabanya stress kunini mbere (gukira gukiza), si ukurikira izina cyangwa ingengo.
planning.component_policy_alert_lead: {{names}} — stress y'amateka iracyongera ku bice birenga n'imvange y'ubu.
planning.component_policy_alert_close: Tekereza kohereza ingengo ivuye ku mabice ahariho agahe kugeza ku bikenewe stress gikomeye, ugumye igiteranyo cy'igihugu kiboneye.
planning.budget_increase_hint: Ingengo y'imari yongewe kugira ngo ugeze k'ingongo. Si ngaruka y'imari.
planning.section_multiyear_desc: Intambwe, impinduka y'ingengo n'ibyagezweho k'igihe cyatoranijwe.
planning.section_mtef_desc: Gahunda y'imyaka 3 itandukanye, ingongo yayo (% ijanisha) n'iyongera y'ingengo.
planning.trajectory_help: Biteganijwe n'ingongo y'umwaka; urwego rw'icyatsi ni ingongo y'urwego.
planning.insights_help: Kugira ngo habe gahunda y'amategeko n'imyitozo.
planning.mtef_help: Gahunda y'imyaka 3 hamwe n'ijanisha n'iyongera y'ingengo.
planning.mtef_diff_note: MTEF ni gahunda y'imyaka 3 itandukanye: ikoresha ijanisha ry'igipimo n'iyongera y'ingengo. Ingongo y'umwaka 3 = intangiriro × (1 − %), si ingongo y'umwaka 5 y'igirabi. FSFSI biteganijwe bishobora kuba byiza kuruta iyo ingongo niba iyongera y'ingengo ni nini.
planning.saved_plans_help: Fungura gahunda, shyira imwe nk'ikoreshwa ku rwego rw'igihugu, cyangwa utangire gahunda nshya. Hitamo kugeza ku gahunda eshatu kugereranya intambwe.
planning.saved_plans_empty: Nta gahunda yabitswe ku mwaka w'imari. Hanga gahunda hepfo, hanyuma Bika.
planning.viewing_saved: Uri kureba gahunda yabitswe. Hindura ibisabwa ukande Hanga gahunda, cyangwa Tangira gahunda nshya.
planning.compare_help: Ibisabwa hamwe n'intambwe ya FSFSI (gahunda y'imyaka myinshi gusa).
planning.saved_different_assessment: Iyi gahunda yabitswe kuva ku isuzuma ritandukanye. Ongera usuzume niba ukeneye imibare ihuye n'ubu.
planning.save_new_help: Izina ry'ingingo rigomba kuba ridasohoka ku mwaka w'imari (ntabwo ikubiyemo inyuguti). Gushya gahunda gusiba iya mbere yari ikoreshwa.
planning.save_update_help: Guhindura ibisabwa cyangwa ibipimo bishya byongera gutunganya inzira yabitswe. Izina rigomba gukomeza kuba ridasohoka.
planning.delete_confirm: Gusiba burundu iyi gahunda? Ntibishobora gusubizwanyuma.

budget_page.title: Isesengura ry'Ingengo y'Imari
budget_page.subtitle: Kurikirana uko ingengo y'imari y'ubuhinzi n'ibice by'uburyo bwo kugira ibiribwa mu Rwanda ihuza mu myaka y'ingengo (mds LCU).
budget_page.scope_note: Ibi biva mu makuru y'ingengo y'imari yashyizwe ku murongo, bitari mu amanota y'isuzuma FSFSI.
budget_page.no_data: Nta makuru y'ingengo yahujwe. Kora import_budget_mapping (intambwe ya 1).
budget_page.metric_hhi_hint: Mu bice by'uburyo bwo kugira ibiribwa
budget_page.metric_mapping_confidence_hint: Igice cy'imirongo yahujwe neza muri FY{{year}} (100% itasuwe n'agateganyo). Birenga = uruhare rurerure ku ma programmes.
budget_page.chart_spike_note: +{{yoy}}% kuva FY{{prevYear}} kugeza FY{{year}}. Guhita kwiyongera kunogera indi mpinduka y'imari, guhindura ibice, cyangwa uburyo bwo guhuza — reba neza mbere yo kubitwara nk'impinduka y'ingengo y'imari gusa.
budget_page.chart_general_caveat: Imibare ihuzanya n'imigenero n'agateganyo. Soma hamwe n'ukwizerwa no mu rutonde rw'ubundi bw'ihuzo.
budget_page.chart_share_title: Ibice binini, igice ku mubare wose
budget_page.chart_share_help: % ku mubare wose (bitanu binini ku mwaka wa nyuma).
budget_page.insights_subtitle: Ibisomwa bigamije gufata ingingo — huza n'ibirindi byo kwemeza.
budget_page.section_reference_intro: Bisobanura ku bakoresha ubwenge no guhugura.
budget_page.movers_help: Imyanya ikoresha byifuzwa buri mwaka. Impinduka ku rwego na CAGR zikeneye ingengo nziza ku mbere (na CAGR na ku nyuma). Gutangira ku busa bituma % itaboneka. Impinduka y'igice (ppt) : impinduka y'igice cy'impimbano ku mubare w'igihugu.
budget_page.mover_cagr_hint: Guhaguruka kw'ingengo y'impimbano ; gusa iyo mbere n'inyuma ziri hejuru ya zero.
budget_page.mover_cagr_caveat: CAGR nkiran-y'ukwinshi risobanura ubushobozi buke bw'ingengo mu mwaka wa mbere — reba impinduka y'igice (ppt).
budget_page.mover_footnote_cagr: * CAGR nkirenga cyangwa ingengo ya(mbere) nto — koresha tooltip.
budget_page.mover_level_hint: Impinduka % ku byifuzwa vs umwaka wa mbere ; gusa iyo mbere iri hejuru ya zero.
budget_page.mover_share_hint: Impinduka mu bice bya pasentasi ku mubare w'igihugu (mbere vs nyuma).
budget_page.snapshot_help: Urutonde rwuzuye ku mwaka wa nyuma w'intera.
budget_page.snapshot_auto_hint: Ibyo ku mwaka wa nyuma bipakira ubwayo.
